title: Morning or Afternoon Berlin Walking Tour - Quick Summary
items: **Let the season pick the time.** Winter: the middle of the day. A hot summer day: the morning. Spring and autumn: either, so the appointment you cannot move decides.
**December daylight is short.** On 21 December the sun rises over Berlin at 08:15 and sets at 15:54. Start an outdoor walk by midday.
**Summer heat peaks late.** On two summer days out of three the highest reading of the day comes at 16:00, 17:00 or 18:00. On a 30 °C day it is about six degrees cooler at 10:00 than at 16:00.

**The Museum Island museums are closed on Mondays.** On other days they open at 10:00. The Neues Museum and the Alte Nationalgalerie close at 18:00, the Altes Museum and the Bode-Museum at 17:00 from Tuesday to Friday.
**Settle lunch before you book.** A 12:30 walk runs through lunchtime: eat before noon and have coffee afterwards.
**My own walk, Berlin Then and Now, has one start: 12:30** at the World Clock on Alexanderplatz. It ends at Hackescher Markt at about 15:00, costs €25 per person and takes no more than 10 people.
**At 15:00 in the dark months you have about an hour of daylight left.** From mid-November to mid-January the sun sets between about 15:50 and 16:20. Do the outdoor part first, then go inside.
